summary: Nexxen International Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed Israeli ad-tech issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting board changes after its September 29, 2026 AGM. Former Chairperson Christopher Stibbs did not stand for re-election after seven years of service; Senior Independent Director Neil Jones was appointed Interim Board Chairperson effective immediately. The board now has five directors, four independent. Daniel Kerstein chairs the Sustainability, Nomination and Governance Committee. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is disclosed. Routine governance transition; no risk-arb angle, though eventual permanent chair selection and board composition bear watching.
